name: GiveWell
summary: Researches global health and poverty programmes and directs donors' money to the most cost-effective ones it finds: $397 million in 2024 and $427 million in 2025, from its Top Charities to newer programmes funded by grants. A gift to its Unrestricted Fund pays for its research and operations; money beyond what it can use goes to grants.

spending.source: https://files.givewell.org/files/ClearFund/Clear%20Fund%202024%20audited%20financial%20statements%20(PDF).pdf (The Clear Fund d.b.a. GiveWell, audited consolidated statements, year to 31 December 2024: programme services $177,309K, of which grants $163,148K; the grants are donors' money passed on to the charities GiveWell funds, counted in their own models, so the programme here is research, grantmaking and outreach, $14,161K. Management and general $5,854K, fundraising $726K.)

lines.label: Research, grantmaking and donor outreach
lines.source: https://files.givewell.org/files/ClearFund/Clear%20Fund%202024%20audited%20financial%20statements%20(PDF).pdf (Statement of Functional Expenses, programme column less grants: salaries, benefits, recruitment, advertising, outreach, professional fees and other costs of its research and outreach; the accounts give no further programme split)
